sum: Critical Metals Corp. operates as a mining exploration and development company in Germany, Austria, and Greenland. The company explores for lithium and rare earth element deposits. Its flagship project is the Tanbreez Project located in the Kujalleq region of southern Greenland. The company is headquartered in New York, New York.
ceo: Mr. Antony William-Paul Sage B.Bus, B.Com., C.A., FCPA, FTIA (Executive Chairman of the Board & CEO)
